title: 第10章 暗度陈仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这是一场改写中国历史的千年奇谋，前206年，中国历史的棋局上一场看似不起眼的战役悄然展开。这场战役中，一位被后世称为“兵仙神帅”的军事奇才用一计“明修栈道，暗度陈仓”将兵法中的虚实之道发挥到极致，不仅让刘邦逆风翻盘，更奠定了大汉的基石。

秦朝灭亡后，项羽凭借巨鹿之战的威名自封“西楚霸王”，成为天下诸侯的共主。然而，刘邦的崛起让他如芒在背。按约定，“先入关中者王之”，但项羽却将刘邦封为汉王，发配到偏远的巴蜀和汉中，并将关中分给三位秦朝降将章邯、司马欣、董翳，号称“三秦”，意图用地理锁链困死刘邦。

刘邦的南郑都城四面环山，唯一的通道是穿越秦岭的栈道，这些在悬崖绝壁上凿孔架木而成的险路稍有不慎便会坠入深渊。为了向项羽示弱，刘邦采纳张良之计，烧毁了所有栈道，仿佛在说：“我永不出山！”

此举成功麻痹了项羽，但也让汉军陷入孤立无援的境地。在汉中，刘邦遇到了人生的转折点——韩信，这位曾受“胯下之辱”的落魄青年被萧何力荐为大将。

韩信一针见血指出：项羽虽强，却刚愎自用。关中虽险，但民心在汉。他提出东出三秦，再争天下的战略，而第一步便是突破章邯的封锁。

现在我们回看历史觉得“明修栈道，暗度陈仓”是个人都能搞定，不就是声东击西吗？假装给你脸上一电炮，其实是照你裤裆来一脚，敌人直接躺下了，然后收工。

但是章邯不傻，呼啦啦一帮人哐当哐当往山上钉木桩、架栈道，章邯会看不出来？其实这里面包含着复杂的运算。

首先，汉军必须出来，不出来就是坐以待毙。其次，要快，不然三秦防线布好，那也是死。但汉王怎么出？秦岭漫漫不算，秦岭外的敌人正是秦末第一名将章邯，是带着骊山囚徒都能打死项梁、跟项羽PK的男人。而且章邯是秦人，不管是关中还是秦岭，章邯都更熟悉。另外章邯还不是一个人，还有司马欣和董翳。三秦三个王盯着你们呢。

更何况现在还不是能不能打赢他俩的问题，而是能不能出去跟他们打。当时的布置是章邯守三秦，刘邦一出，直接揍他。万一有意外，项羽过来救。这就等于三个玩家抡着锤子打地鼠呢，就问你愁不愁人。

所以目前的形势是刘邦要出关就要翻越秦岭，翻过去还得打赢三秦王，然后才能争取到跟项羽PK的资格。不过，拿什么跟人家PK呢？来的时候兵力也就三四万，因为没希望，天天有人跑。得亏有萧何招兵买马，不过兵都是新的，没打过仗。大将军韩信也是新招的，而且这个大将军一上岗就是“还定三秦”这个大项目。你是老板，有没有这个胆量和魄力？啥也别说了，先研究一下军事地图吧，先数一数都有几条道？

一是褒斜道，来的时候就走的这条路，现在烧了。二是子午道，章邯拎着锤子等着呢，去了就是送死。三是祁山道，远、迂回，后来诸葛亮六出祁山累死的那条。四是傥骆道，太短，对刘邦帮助不大。也有专家分析说傥骆道在楚汉时期还算不上道路，所以这条不算。五是陈仓道，破败、小，而且章邯也已经派人守着呢。

不算傥骆道，共四条路，情况就这个操蛋，不好走不说，章邯还热情的到七月份就禁了商旅，他可不管刘邦是否有本事出去，盯得死死的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

This is a thousand-year conspiracy that rewrites Chinese history. In 206 BC, a seemingly inconspicuous battle on the chessboard of Chinese history quietly unfolded.In this battle, a military wizard who was known as the "Soldier Immortal Commander" by later generations used the strategy of "building plank roads in the open and concealing the warehouses" to bring the virtual reality in the art of war to the extreme. This not only allowed Liu Bang to turn against the wind, but also laid the foundation of the Han Dynasty.

After the fall of the Qin Dynasty, Xiang Yu relied on his reputation in the Battle of Julu to proclaim himself the "Overlord of Western Chu" and became the co-lord of all the princes in the world.However, the rise of Liu Bang put a ray of light on his back.According to the agreement, "the one who enters Guanzhong first will be king", but Xiang Yu named Liu Bang the King of Han and sent him to the remote areas of Bashu and Hanzhong. He also assigned Guanzhong to three Qin Dynasty surrender generals Zhang Han, Sima Xin, and Dong Yi, known as the "Three Qins", with the intention of trapping Liu Bang with geographical chains.

Liu Bang's capital city of Nanzheng is surrounded by mountains, and the only access is the plank road through the Qinling Mountains. These dangerous roads made of holes drilled in the cliffs and timbers will fall into the abyss if you are not careful.In order to show weakness to Xiang Yu, Liu Bang adopted Zhang Liang's plan and burned down all the plank roads, as if to say: "I will never leave the mountain!"

This move successfully paralyzed Xiang Yu, but it also left the Han army in an isolated and helpless situation.In Hanzhong, Liu Bang encountered a turning point in his life - Han Xin. This down-and-out young man who had been "humiliated under the crotch" was recommended as a general by Xiao He.

Han Xin pointed out to the point: Although Xiang Yu is strong, he is also willful.Although Guanzhong is dangerous, the people's hearts are with Han.He proposed the strategy of going east to the Three Qin Dynasties and then conquering the world, and the first step was to break through Zhang Han's blockade.

Now when we look back at history, we feel that "building plank roads openly and building warehouses secretly" can be done by one person, isn't it just a matter of attacking in the east and attacking in the west?Pretending to hit you in the face with an electric cannon, he actually kicks you in the crotch. The enemy will just lie down and call it a day.

But Zhang Han is not stupid. With a group of people banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, banging, nailing wooden stakes and building a plank road on the mountain, Zhang Han can't see it?In fact, it contains complex operations.

First of all, the Han army must come out. If they don't come out, they will just sit and wait for death.Secondly, we have to be quick, otherwise if the Sanqin defense line is set up, it will be death.But how did the King of Han appear?Not counting the long Qinling Mountains, the enemy outside the Qinling Mountains was none other than Zhang Han, the number one general in the late Qin Dynasty. He was a man who could kill Xiang Liang and compete with Xiang Yu with the prisoners of Lishan Mountain.Moreover, Zhang Han is from Qin. Whether it is Guanzhong or Qinling, Zhang Han is more familiar with it.In addition, Zhang Han is not alone, there are also Sima Xin and Dong Yi.The three kings of Sanqin are watching you.

What's more, the question now is not whether we can beat them, but whether we can go out and fight them.The arrangement at that time was for Zhang Han to guard the Three Qin Dynasty. When Liu Bang came out, he would beat him directly.If there is an accident, Xiang Yu comes to rescue.This is equivalent to three players playing whack-a-mole with hammers, asking if you are worried about others.

So the current situation is that Liu Bang has to cross the Qinling Mountains to get out of the customs, and he has to defeat the Three Qin Kings before he can get the qualification to PK with Xiang Yu.However, what should I use to compete with others?When we came, we only had 30,000 to 40,000 troops. Because there was no hope, people ran away every day.Fortunately, Xiao He recruited troops, but the soldiers were all new and had never fought before.General Han Xin is also a new recruit, and as soon as this general took office, he started the big project of "returning the Three Qins".You are the boss, do you have the courage and courage?Don't say anything else. Let's study the military map first. How many roads are there?

One is Baoxie Road. The road I took when I came here is now burned.The second is Ziwu Road. Zhang Han is waiting with a hammer. If he goes there, he will die.The third is the Qishan Road, which is far and circuitous. Later, Zhuge Liang died of exhaustion on his sixth trip to Qishan.The fourth is the Tangluo Road, which is too short and of little help to Liu Bang.Some experts also analyzed that the Tangluo Road was not considered a road during the Chu and Han Dynasties, so this one does not count.Fifth, Chencang Road is dilapidated and small, and Zhang Han has already sent people to guard it.

Not counting the Tangluo Road, there are four roads in total. The situation is fucked. Not to mention that it is difficult to walk, Zhang Han even enthusiastically banned business travel in July. He didn't care whether Liu Bang had the ability to go out, and kept a close eye on him.
